Bloons TD 6 is, of course, the 6th mainline entry into the bloons TD franchise and it is by far in a way the best out of all of them. The game play is fun and stressful in a good way, the visuals are bright, and beautiful, the music is catchy and cheery. The are a couple of sour spot for me personally, the home menu is crowded and busy, their are micro transactions, how ever you earn enough monkey money, the games main currency through normal game play. And also theres the difficulty. Now im not going to pull a cuphead journalist and tell you its impossible, but it can be a little, cheap. Later on in waves you go against increadibly fast, hard hitting bloons and it almost feels like the difficulty slider is constantly being thrown around, youve got super easy waves right next to some of the hardest waves in the game like wave 76. Fuck wave 76. But aside from the difficulty the game is a super fun tower defence game in an era where their arent really any TD games left. If you like TD games, the bloons genre or difficult games, youll love this one. 7/10

With 80 hours invested into the game, I feel like I can safely call it a positive experience. For someone like me, who's loved the simple idea of the Bloons games since childhood - I would very deeply recommend at least trying this out. I just love how the player can dive into the game with 0 experience nor knowledge in it, completely unconscious as to what they might encounter OR have whopping amounts of hours spent, and still be having fun. It's just the fact that the game has much depth and thought put behind it, but is still simple enough for a newbie to have a blast popping Bloons, too.

Things I like:

Art style, the colors and the overall visual presentation are on point
Heroes, they vary greatly - and each Hero is fun to use in their own way
Towers, there's a vast amount of them - each one having their own amazing characteristics
Effects, music, sounds and their settings, they're all top notch in my opinion

Things I'd like more thought put into:

Co-Op, would like to see better connectivity and improved features for communicating
Events, the game seems to tell players a bit too little about certain events
Updates, it feels like winning the lottery seeing an update get released, that's how rare they are
Heroes, the cost of new Heroes and their individual skins are in the stratosphere, they should be way more affordable
I recommend 90% of games made by ninja kiwi, BTD6 and BTD5 are the best tower defence games in existence.

The variety of effective strategies in the game are what makes it so fun. As new monkeys, upgrades, and monkey knowledge is unlocked you are encouraged to experiment and try new strategies. That being said there is still a wealth of content in this game that will keep most entertained for well over 50 hours, and updates adding new heroes, maps, and bosses keep the game fresh enough to come back to after each update.

After about 300 collective hours on many different devices, I'm finally making a review.
This game is quite easy to learn, but hard to master. It will take time and patience to unlock everything, but most importantly, alot of monkeys.
The normal modes are quite easy, until you get to the alterations and CHIMPS mode.
Then, you've got time attacks, which are sprints where you can skip rounds, which is quite competitive. And Boss Bloons are bloons that take many hours of experience to do specific planning for each type, which there are currently 6 different bosses.
The clans are quite nice for meeting people, although there's no chat, and good for rewards through the two main events, Contested Territory and Bosh Rush.
Finally, there's collection events where completing maps gives you the tokens you need to collect for the event. Personally, never grinded them.
The many types of towers are really nice to play with, due to the amount of strategy this game takes which strategy is a strong suit of mine.
And the final thing I'd like to note is the monkey knowledge, which are 6 sets of knowledge trees that use monkey knowledge points and monkey money to unlock permanent boosts to your game, which you can disable at any time. (Always disabled in CHIMPS)
Overall, 9/10 game, really like it and you'll have to try it for yourself.

Bloons Tower Defense 6 is a strange game to see. I remember playing the flash versions of 1-3 when Adobe Flash was a thing. Overall, I have to say that I find BTD6 to be a pleasant experience. I would only recommend picking it up on sale, if you do not mind waiting. It is worth the price asked, and I find it to be basic, albeit fun to distract yourself with. My one negative gripe is the addition of Micro transactions, but this is happily avoidable for the most part, as they only provide slight bonuses and benefits to the game. That said, these bonuses do add up, and while there are PVE coop modes, there are also PVP time trial modes that this expanded system can affect.

Overall, I give BTD6 a solid 8/10. It loses points for repetitiveness, and Microtransactions being a core part of leveling your account quickly.

Without a doubt, the best game in the series to date. I have played Bloons since it began as an internet Flash game, and Ninja Kiwi has continually improved upon the systems and mechanics of the game on each new title. In addition to the new 3D models and environments, the devs tweaked the already solid multi-path tower upgrade mechanics of BTD 5 just right to provide seemingly endless freedom to how you play BTD 6. In previous titles, there was always *that tower* (or set of towers) you always needed to use to be able to handle a certain type of balloon on a certain round. BTD 6 finally gives you the freedom to make a huge variety of defenses work, without having to fall back on a certain prescribed set of towers to accomplish a given task. This really improves the experience and provides the player with many more strategic options, allowing you to get creative and extending the entertainment you get out of the reasonably low price tag.

Long story short, if you like tower defense games, the level of refinement in this game truly makes it the best game of the genre. You won't regret giving it a try.

The new system of having to pay money for every monkey knowledge is disgusting. I've never posted a review for a game until now because of how much this bothered me. We payed 10 dollars for bloons, we already payed the money for a game that was marketed as having OPTIONAL micro transactions for plenty of optional things. You can't go from having a free to play leveling up system to suddenly requiring a ton of real money just to play the game. The amount it requires to get any decent monkey knowledge tiers is absurdly high and its not what I signed up for when I originally purchased the game. This is grounds for many people to outright refund their game in my opinion as its changing how the game works and making it an even bigger cash grab.

Don't buy this game until this change is revoked, its not worth it anymore.

Anyways, this is such a great game, building off of the success and fun of previous iterations. Super addicting and a blast to play with friends in co-op.
